chose: A line is stale when, at a later commit, its source's file is gone or what it cited (its quote, else its lines' text) is no longer anywhere in the file, whitespace aside: a cited passage that only moved is not stale. A source that can't be read at either commit is reported as not followed and fails the command, never counted fresh.
options: cited text still in the file, anywhere (this)
cited lines unchanged at the same line numbers
the file unchanged since the stamp
gray: How sensitive the re-check is sets how often the owner is told an essay is stale; too eager and every unrelated edit flags it, too lax and a changed fact passes.
undo: Change the comparison in staleClaims (claims.ts); nothing stores its verdicts.
